item.title: Shanghai Yaoxue Snow World: Unlimited Skiing for Two + Hot Springs — ¥999 (≈$141)
item.description:
Deal price: unlimited intermediate/advanced skiing for two + hot spring visit for two — ¥999 (≈$141, was ¥1,396, about 28% off) · Valid Nov 3 – Dec 31, 2026 · Book one day ahead

Yaoxue Snow World （耀雪冰雪世界） in Lingang is a 98,000㎡ indoor snow park held at −3 to −5°C all year — real snow, indoors, in Shanghai. There are five slopes: two beginner runs (the green run and the practice slope) plus blue, red and black runs for intermediate and advanced skiers, with a magic carpet and an indoor cable car. The headline ¥999 ticket covers unlimited time on the intermediate/advanced slopes for two people, with one gear rental each (ski suit, skis or snowboard, boots, poles and helmet, no deposit), plus a hot spring visit for two at the Crowne Plaza hotel next door (bring swimwear).

item.title: Xiamen Lingling Circus City: Animal Kingdom Ticket ¥79 (≈$11) or Circus Show + Zoo ¥159 (≈$22)
item.description:
Deal price: Animal Kingdom ticket — ¥79 (≈$11, was ¥140, about 44% off) · Circus show ticket with same-day zoo entry — ¥159 (≈$22, was ¥280) · On sale Nov 7–20, 2026 · Valid for any day to Dec 31, 2026

Lingling International Circus City （灵玲国际马戏城） in Jimei is Xiamen’s big family day out: a zoo and a world-class circus in one park. The Animal Kingdom is home to giant pandas, giraffes, brown bears, white tigers, alpacas, parrots and ring-tailed lemurs — the animals head indoors at 17:00, so go earlier in the day. The circus show, Forest Secrets, plays in a Guinness-record big-top theatre with a water-and-land dual stage, fountains and fire effects, and the Kenyan Death Wheel act, newly upgraded from 4 wheels to 6 and raised to 17 metres. The ¥159 ticket covers the circus show and includes same-day entry to the Animal Kingdom, so one ticket does the whole park.

item.title: Yujian Minnan, Xiamen: Family Ticket for 1 Adult + 2 Kids — ¥99 (≈$14)
item.description:
Deal price: family ticket for 1 adult + 2 kids — ¥99 (≈$14, was ¥286, about 65% off) · Valid Nov 4–30, 2026 · Book 30 minutes ahead

Yujian Minnan （屿见闽南） is an immersive theme park in Huli District that drops you into old coastal Fujian: Minnan-style streets and courtyards, costumed NPC characters wandering the park to chat and play, live performances, and a stamp-collection game — gather the stamps and the kids can redeem a souvenir popsicle. It is all indoors, so it works in any weather, and it photographs beautifully in traditional dress. This autumn family ticket covers 1 adult plus 2 children (one aged 16 or under, one aged 6 or under).

item.title: Qingdao Sunac Land 2-Day Ticket — ¥69 (≈$10): 10 Rides Unlimited, Valid to Nov 15
item.description:
Deal price: 2-day ticket, 10 rides unlimited — ¥69 (≈$10, was ¥158, about 56% off) · Valid Nov 5–15, 2026 · Use on 2 consecutive days

Qingdao Sunac Land (in Sunac Mall, Huangdao) is offering a 2-day autumn-break ticket at less than half price: ¥69 covers 10 rides, unlimited, across two consecutive days — you cannot split the two days. The line-up: Laoshan Flying Dragon coaster, carousel, pirate ship, kids’ driving school, crazy pendulum, rolling music boat, bumper cars, basket Ferris wheel, samba balloons and the sky-drop tower. Buy and use — no ticket exchange needed.

item.title: Beijing Chocolate Museum from ¥29.9 (≈$4): Single Ticket with Stamp Booklet, was ¥198 — Family Ticket ¥198 with DIY
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult single ticket (with stamp booklet) — ¥29.9 (≈$4, was ¥198, about 85% off) · Valid Apr 2 – Dec 31, 2026 · Buy and use instantly · Refundable anytime

The Chocolate Museum (巧克巧蔻, Beijing branch) is a small, sweet museum that mixes chocolate art appreciation, chocolate knowledge, hands-on experiences and a boutique shop — a light, fun stop that works well with kids on a Beijing city day. The single ticket includes a stamp booklet to collect as you go around; the family ticket adds a proper hands-on element, with an advanced DIY session where you make your own chocolates (six pieces, plus a cherry chocolate) and two stamp booklets.

item.title: Paradox Museum Shanghai (The Bund) from ¥59 (≈$8): Single Ticket to 50+ Immersive Illusion Experiences, was ¥158
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult single ticket — ¥59 (≈$8, was ¥158, about 63% off) · Valid Nov 6 – Dec 31, 2026 · Buy and use instantly · Refundable anytime · Money-Saver Card saves another ¥30

Paradox Museum has just opened its Bund branch in the heart of the Nanjing East Road pedestrian street — inside Central Plaza, a short walk from the Bund waterfront. It is a walk-through illusion museum: 50+ immersive paradox exhibits built around optical illusions, reversed rooms and hands-on trickery, designed to be photographed as much as looked at. It is a compact, one-hour-style stop rather than a half-day museum, which makes it an easy add-on between the Bund and Nanjing Road shopping.

item.title: Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park Tickets from ¥99 (≈$14): Orca Show, Birthday & Student Deals
item.description:
Deal price: birthday or student ticket — ¥99 (≈$14, was ¥299 for birthday / ¥150 for student) · Adult ticket ¥229 (≈$32, was ¥299) · November dates, buy at least 1 day ahead · Refundable if unused

Shanghai Haichang Ocean Park is Shanghai’s big ocean park, home to about 100,000 marine animals — the headline is the orca show “The Legend of the Killer Whale”, plus dolphins, beluga whales, sea lions and a polar bear, across six ocean shows. The park’s Ocean Show Festival runs to November 15, with a fireworks show on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights, and a new Arabian-themed riverside zone with 200 performers and 200+ games. Park hours in November: 9:30–21:00 for Nov 1–15, 9:30–19:00 for Nov 16–30.

item.title: Suzhou Paradise Forest World Annual Pass from ¥365 (≈$51): 30+ Rides, Family Pass ¥798, Valid to Dec 2027
item.description:
Deal price: single annual pass — ¥365 (≈$51, was ¥888, about 59% off) · Activate by Dec 31, 2027 · Valid from activation to Dec 31, 2027 · Refundable if unactivated

Suzhou Paradise Forest World is a forest-themed park with 30+ rides and attractions, and kids’ facilities make up a good share of them — a solid pick if you live in or near Suzhou and go to theme parks more than once a year. One pass covers unlimited visits from the day you activate it through December 31, 2027, so even two visits beat the single-day price. Park hours are 9:15–17:15, with night sessions on holidays per the park’s notice.

item.title: Hangzhou Wind Valley Grassland Play Pass from ¥99 (≈$14): Trains, Rides & Slides on 3,000 Mu of Grassland
item.description:
Deal price: child play pass — ¥99 (≈$14, was ¥228) · Adult pass ¥168 · Valid September 1 – December 20, 2026 · Buy and use the same day

Wind Valley （风之谷） is 3,000 mu of open grassland in the hills of Lin’an, about 90 minutes’ drive from central Hangzhou — the place guests keep calling “Hangzhou’s Altay”. One pass covers entry plus the grassland train and mini train (“the train to autumn”) and 10+ rides: the jungle flyer, New Zealand scooter, rainbow slide, bamboo raft, grass flying, bumper cars, tank battle and more. Two rides — the sky flyer and the super slide — need riders 1.4 m and up. Tents dot the grassland if you want to slow down between rides, and the site runs interactive activities through the day.

item.title: Beijing Bird Paradise Exploration Park from ¥59.9 (≈$8): Forest Bird Encounters in Wenyu River Park
item.description:
Deal price: single ticket — ¥59.9 (≈$8, was ¥129) · 1 adult + 1 child ¥99 (was ¥199), 2 adults + 1 child ¥139 (was ¥299) · Opened September 2026 in Wenyu River Park · Valid September 17 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ buy and use on the spot, refundable if unused

Opened in September 2026 inside Wenyu River Park’s Chaoyang demonstration area, the Bird Paradise Exploration Park blends native forest, bird shows, petting animals and wooden playgrounds into one family day out. The centrepiece is the parrot stunt show — trained parrots ride tiny bicycles, play basketball and bowl, presented by a team with 20+ years of bird training — followed by close-up feeding and photos with macaws and cockatoos. The petting farm has alpacas, raccoons, sika deer and rabbits to feed under keeper supervision, and the forest playgrounds are all wooden and unpowered: a giant grasshopper slide and butterfly climbing frame for ages 3–6, a shallow stream area for splashing and catching fish, and a giant bird-nest climbing tower with rope bridges and spiral slides for ages 6+.

item.title: Hangzhou Koala Jungle Adventure from ¥99 (≈$14): Treetop Ropes Courses in the Forest at Senbo Resort
item.description:
Deal price: single ticket, any 2 of 3 courses — ¥99 (≈$14, was ¥128) · All 3 courses ¥129 (was ¥188) · Valid September 15 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ buy by 23:59 the day before

Inside Hangzhou Senbo Resort by Xiang Lake, Koala Jungle is a 4,000-square-metre treetop adventure park: 40+ crossings strung through the forest — suspension bridges, a Tarzan jump, high swings and a 70-metre Andes zipline — plus a 12-metre climbing wall. The equipment is French-imported, and coaches supervise every course. Three routes run by difficulty: green (1.2 m+), blue (1.2 m+) and red (1.4 m+), so families can start easy and work up; children 1.2 m and under do the green and blue routes with a parent alongside. A free resort shuttle runs from the hotel lobby to the course.

item.title: Hangzhou Paradise Double-11 Tickets from ¥99.9 (≈$14): Single ¥99.9 or Double ¥169.9, Entry from Noon
item.description:
Deal price: single ticket — ¥99.9 (≈$14, was ¥190) · Double ticket ¥169.9 (≈$24, was ¥380) · Entry from 12:00 · Valid November 2–30, 2026 · ⏰ buy at least 1 day ahead, refundable if unused

Hangzhou Paradise is one of the Yangtze Delta’s big all-round theme parks, split into themed zones — Maya Tribe, Lost Jungle, Adventure Island — with dozens of thrill rides, kids’ rides and live shows. The headline rides are the Maya Roller Coaster (an 800-metre red dragon hitting 80 km/h), the 60-metre Rain God Hammer swing, the Wind God Hand, a white-water flume, bumper cars and a carousel, plus a carnival parade with floats and performers. One ticket covers the whole park for the afternoon.

item.title: Shanghai Trampoline Park (Bounce Town) from ¥39.9 (≈$6): All-Day Play for 1 Adult or 1 Adult + 1 Child
item.description:
Deal price: single all-day ticket — ¥39.9 (≈$6, was ¥159) · 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.4 m) ¥49.9 (≈$7, was ¥199) · Valid September 1 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ Tuesday–Sunday 10:00–20:30, buy and use on the spot

Bounce Town (弹力小镇) in Jiading is a 4,000-square-metre trampoline park that plays more like a whole indoor playground: rows of trampolines, a near-vertical giant slide and gentler wave slides for younger kids, a high-altitude walkway, go-karts, plum-blossom poles, archery and shooting, a climbing net and a rock wall — plus a 300-square-metre soft-play toddler zone on the second floor with a pretend supermarket. One ticket covers the whole day with unlimited replays, and parking is free for 4 hours.
